{{Quote|The people and leaders of Woostri, on the other hand, are a different matter entirely. Like the Ukians, they have a strong fear of the unknown and what they perceive to be the impossible. Equally important, they have a tendency to magnify rumors of menace far out of proportion. The cloaked cruiser stratagem should work quite well there.|Grand Admiral Thrawn to Joruus C'baoth|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Woostri''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

As [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had expected, the [[Woostoid]]s quickly surrendered after Thrawn used the stratagem of [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] cruisers bombarding the planet from under the surface of a planetary shield, in coordination with an orbital bombardment by the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet.
